name: missing_healthchecks
title: mlflow and flask-app have no healthcheck

found_by.how: Seen during the reference run: docker compose ps shows no health for mlflow and flask-app; confirmed with docker inspect.

command: docker inspect mlops-zoomcamp-project-mlflow-1 mlops-zoomcamp-project-flask-app-1 --format '{{.Name}} health={{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none (no healthcheck){{end}}'

cause.summary: No healthcheck on two services that others call
details: docker-compose.yaml: mlflow (line 329) and flask-app (line 374) define no healthcheck.
Nothing can wait for them with depends_on: condition: service_healthy; a crashed or still-starting MLflow server shows as Up. flask-app also doesn't depend on localstack, which it needs for /reload.
The API has no /health route either (GET /health -> 404), so a healthcheck for flask-app has to call GET / or a new route.

fix.summary: Add healthchecks to mlflow and flask-app
fix.action: mlflow: GET http://localhost:5000/health; flask-app: GET http://localhost:8000/ (or /health once the adapter adds it); then depends_on with condition: service_healthy.

static_check.rule: a long-running service (with ports, called by other services) has no healthcheck

reproduce.how: Start the stack and inspect the two containers' health.
reproduce.command: docker compose up -d mlflow flask-app && docker inspect <containers> --format '{{.State.Health}}'
reproduce.note: Not a crash: the gap shows up as no health status.
